figurative_meaning_en: Repetition of the same act to exact revenge
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুর উপর চোখের বদলে চোখ নিলো।
যুদ্ধে দেশগুলো চোখের বদলে চোখের নীতি অনুসরণ করলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He took an eye for an eye against his enemy.
The countries followed an eye-for-an-eye policy in the war.
history: Derived from ancient legal codes like the Code of Hammurabi and the biblical principle of 'an eye for an eye' from the Old Testament.
note: This idiom emphasizes proportional retaliation and is widely used in Bengali literature and everyday discourse.
